name: Before The End
source:
You're dead. But, you've been given one final opportunity before the end. Speak to your loved ones and find peace, in this short VN.

[From [url=https://supremelordalex.itch.io/before-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你死定了。但是，在结束之前你已经获得了最后一次机会。在这段简短的越南语中，与你所爱的人交谈并寻求平静。

[来自[url=https://supremelordalex.itch.io/before-the-end]itch.io[/url]]
